rue_commercante.alt: La rue Commerçante: a cobbled shopping street lined with tall shop fronts under striped awnings, each with a door in its own color, red, orange, yellow, lime green, dark green, teal, sky blue, navy blue, purple, pink and white; an archway on the left opens onto the market square, and beside it a narrow dark-green pub front under a brass ship lantern and a ship's-wheel sign has its own dark-red door. Children line up with a tabby cat, a boy films with an old camera, a man in a top hat swaps a hat for a dove, a girl writes at a desk, a stack of books, a rosette and a gold trophy, and a boy carries a crate of red apples.

magasin.name: Le magasin général

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back through the red door to the shopping street

zooms.label: la caisse
zooms.hint: Look closer at the brass till and everyone around it

magasin.alt: The general store: a red door at the back leads out to the street. A squirrel, a hamster, a white duck and two tortoises cross the floor, a shopkeeper serves at his counter, a boy brings a pony, a man unrolls a long paper roll beside a brass till, a pigeon watches, a hyper little boy marches a giant overflowing shopping cart across the floor, and children share a cake by a sack of provisions.

caisse.name: La caisse
caisse.alt: Close-up of the market crate in the general store: a hyper little boy marches a giant overflowing cart past the sack, a pigeon pecks at birdseed, a man perches on a big brass till writing in his book, and two children share a cake, half each.

reserve.name: La réserve

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back out through the orange door to the twilight shopping street

zooms.label: la caisse de jouets
zooms.hint: Look closer at the open toy chest on the rug

reserve.alt: The shop's stockroom at dusk, under an iron gallery and hanging lanterns, painted in ink and gouache, with the orange door ajar onto the twilight street. On the left cakes glow in a lit window, a mouse guards a pile of smiling cardboard boxes, a crow pecks an apple from a girl's wicker basket, a boy on a ladder paints a boot-shaped shop sign on its iron arm, and the grocer tips a pea from her scoop. On the right a passer-by tips his hat, a balloon seller holds his bunch of balloons, a collector peers at his stamp album through a magnifier, the cashier rings up at her brass till, two toddlers share cookies on the counter, a bicycle pannier is piled with baguettes and a mustached shopkeeper sweeps up a puff of dust. In front, Monsieur Verbe buys back a plush rat from a boy over an open toy chest while an old lady licks an ice cream beside her cart.

jouets.name: La caisse de jouets
jouets.alt: Close-up of the open toy chest in the stockroom: Monsieur Verbe in his red beret hands a coin to a little boy to buy back a fluffy gray toy rat, toy blocks and a little fountain fill the chest, a model market town of red-roofed houses with a clock tower stands at the back, in front of it a toy bus depot where a tiny figure in a blue cap sweeps, and an old lady licks a pink ice cream beside her full wire cart.

ventes.name: La salle des ventes

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back out through the yellow door, left ajar onto the rainy shopping street

zooms.label: le lot
zooms.hint: Look closer at the busy carrot stall in the middle of the saleroom

ventes.alt: A rainy blue-gray morning in the auction saleroom, painted in ink and gouache, seen from up high, with the yellow door ajar onto the wet street. On the left a clerk leans out of her little wooden booth, a beaming uncle spreads his arms wide below the arched window, an aunt in a shawl sorts a junk table of teapots, a woman lifts her bidding paddle beside a chair and a hamster runs in its wheel. On the stage Monsieur Verbe in his purple beret hands his old bicycle over to a man in a cap. On the right a man holds up a tower of shoe boxes, a lady in a bonnet hugs a stack of magazines, a parrot perches on the vending machine, a baker tosses a bone to a jumping spaniel, a camel waits with rolled carpets and lanterns and a magpie pecks at a barrel of nuts. In the middle Monsieur Verbe in a gold beret haggles over a busy carrot stall.

lot.name: Le lot
lot.alt: Close-up of the carrot stall in the saleroom: Monsieur Verbe in a gold beret and a painted mustache debates the price with one finger raised, the merchant offers an armful of carrots, a rabbit snips the price with his scissors, a lady in a bonnet carries her basket of carrots, a penguin waddles past with paper shopping bags, and a goat stands beside a toy truck of cabbages.

fleuriste.name: Chez la fleuriste

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back through the lime-green door to the shopping street

zooms.label: la cagette
zooms.hint: Look closer at Grandma and the children busy with flower pots on the floor

fleuriste.alt: The florist's greenhouse: a lime-green door on the right leads out to the street. Roses in a blue-and-white vase, a fern-haired gnome watering, a girl on a ladder among ivy, a rooster, a tiny rosette, a lady in a floral dress followed by bumblebees, a friendly ghost, white lilies, a girl smelling a rose bush, a long wooden trough bursting into flower as it runs back across the paving, and on the floor in front a grandmother and three children busy with flower pots, and in the middle of the paving a little wooden flower stall with a red-and-white striped awning, passed by a sooty-faced coal porter bent under a basket heaped with a sack of coal.

cagette.name: La cagette
cagette.alt: Close-up of the greenhouse floor in low morning sunbeams: a marmot snoozes curled up in a tipped-over flower pot, two frogs leap over a red tulip while a little boy laughs, a little girl pulls a toy truck overflowing with lavender on a string, a grandmother holds up a flowery mug of ringing lily of the valley, and a boy with a trowel plants a flower bulb that glows like a light bulb.

quincaillerie.name: La quincaillerie

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back out through the green door at the back to the shopping street

zooms.label: le bac
zooms.hint: Look closer at the gray metal bin of bricks and the busy corner around it

quincaillerie.alt: A warm, cluttered hardware and materials shop under a green scalloped awning, painted in ink and gouache, with a big window onto the sunny street and a green door ajar at the back. Afternoon light falls across the cobbled floor. On the left a woman rips a length of material, a toy elephant hangs from a single fiber, a fortune-teller gazes into a crystal ball beside a melting wax candle, and a toff in a top hat holds up a bolt of cloth. Below, a collie has its paw stuck to a glue bottle, little sheep stand in a fenced enclosure on a heap of sand, a cat is taped to a plank, and a beetle crawls through sticky resin on a log. In the middle a salesclerk in an apron hurries past with a wobbling tower of paint cans, a cardboard box on toy wheels carries a heavy iron weight, an old tailor sips tea as he sews, and a boy in yellow rubber boots sneezes. High on the right a young cowboy sits on top of the drawer cabinet, swinging his squeaky new leather boots. Below him a little builder yells from a gray metal bin of tumbling bricks, a carpenter holds up yellow plastic and a teak plank, a boy shows off his club badge, a girl with a red bow clatters in wooden clogs and a man in a flat cap sits on his stack of planks.

bac.name: Le bac
bac.alt: A close-up of the gray metal bin corner of the hardware store, in warm ink and gouache: a little builder in a yellow hard hat yells as bricks tumble around him, a carpenter holds up a shiny yellow plastic sheet and a teak plank, a boy in a blue sweater beams over his gold star club badge, a girl with a red bow clatters a yellow wooden clog, and a man in a flat cap sits on his stack of planks. Behind them a salesclerk carries a tower of paint cans, an old tailor sips tea and a boy in yellow rubber boots sneezes.

ferronnerie.name: La ferronnerie

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back through the teal door to the shopping street

zooms.label: le casier
zooms.hint: Look closer at the girl carrying her gleaming box through the sparks on the floor

ferronnerie.alt: The blacksmith's workshop: a teal door at the back leads out to the street. Chains hang from the wall, a monkey swings on a rope, a man plays the guitar on a coil of rope, a blacksmith at his anvil, an iron grille, a friendly robot, a spider on its thread, a marble block, a silver castle, and on the floor in the forge glow a girl carries a gleaming silver leek past a pipe, a beagle and a man ringing a bell.

casier.name: Le casier
casier.alt: Close-up of the forge floor at the blacksmith's in a warm orange glow and flying sparks: a girl in a red bobble hat carries a small box with a shiny silver metallic leek standing upright in it, a yellow chick tweets from inside a big metal pipe lying on the floor beside the bench, a cat sits on a rung of the ladder above a parked wheelbarrow, a copper pot and a brass trumpet quiver on the bench, a beagle sniffs a bronze dog statue, and Don tugs the long red cord to clang the bell.

librairie.name: La librairie

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back through the sky-blue door to the shopping street

zooms.label: le bac à livres
zooms.hint: Look closer at the wheeled book cart in the middle of the shop

librairie.alt: A tall, narrow shophouse bookshop on a rainy morning, painted in ink and gouache, seen from the back of the shop: rain streams down the big front window under the green striped awning, with the wet market street beyond, and a sky-blue glass door leads out to it. Brass lamps glow over a wooden gallery and ladder. On the left a cat turns the page of a giant book and a paper dragon springs out, an iron press squeezes out the morning papers, an old gentleman on a stool reads a first edition with his teacup on its saucer, and a bee with a tiny tablet buzzes along the shelves. In the middle, young booksellers work at a wheeled bargain-book cart, where a parrot types and a squid's ink spreads into an anchor. On the right a girl adds one more book to her wobbly tower, old Al writes his diary, a page boy in velvet carries a ring on a cushion, a tour guide holds up his guidebook with ducks waddling after him, Pa Pierre folds a paper boat, a toy pony rears at a little red car, a blue paper kayak sits on the rug, a girl draws with a rainbow-wrapped pencil, a reader is so lost in his book that a cat sleeps on his head, and a ghost pops out of an old book.

bac_livres.name: Le bac à livres
bac_livres.alt: Close-up of the wheeled bargain-book cart in the rainy-day bookshop, painted in ink and gouache: a parrot pecks a typewriter, typing out a copy of a letter; a tiny wooden dollhouse bookshop has shelves full of books for sale; a squid in a glass jar squirts ink onto a sheet, where it spreads into an anchor; the shop cat sleeps on its recommended book; two young booksellers in caps and aprons hand a book across the cart; a fountain pen in sunglasses and a pink scarf poses; a feather quill scratches out a long manuscript by itself; and a boy reads a manual on building a bookshelf and shrugs.

imprimerie.name: L'imprimerie

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back through the navy-blue door to the shopping street

imprimerie.alt: The print shop: a navy-blue door on the left leads out to the street. Pictures of a bird, a ship and a flower hang on a line, a rocking horse, a kneeling man with a globe, a girl reading a booklet, a painter at a peacock canvas, an old press, a boy reading a letter, a little blue car with wipers, a man unfolding a map by a stool, and on the floor an apprentice boy handing a blank metal spacing block to an old typesetter who presses it into a gap in his tray of type.

bijouterie.name: La bijouterie

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back through the purple door to the shopping street

bijouterie.alt: The jeweler's salon: a purple door at the back leads out to the street. By the arched window an elderly lady in a lilac shawl brushes the sparkling purple brooch pinned to it. A crystal chandelier, a big purple furry monster, a ginger cat, a giant diamond held up by a jeweler, a girl in a round dance, a pearl in an open shell, a chessboard of gold pieces, a collie with a necklace, a peacock, a fan and a cart of gold coins.

mode.name: La boutique de mode

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back through the pink door to the shopping street

mode.alt: The fashion boutique: a pink door at the back leads out to the street. Models in pink and polka dots, a lady whose towering beehive hairdo holds a quail's nest, a swan, a seamstress at a vast pink gown, loaves in a paper bag, a tailor pinning a jacket, a poodle, a suit of armor on a stand, a hairdresser snipping a fluffy wig on a stool while a white duck quacks, a clown at a make-up mirror, a lady in a lilac hat, a bulldog on a pouf, wild boars with a purse, and a tray of glittering jewels.

parfumerie.name: La parfumerie

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back through the white door to the shopping street

zooms.label: le coffre
zooms.hint: Look closer at the big open chest in the middle of the shop

parfumerie.alt: A bright, sunny pastel perfumery in a narrow shophouse, painted in ink and gouache and seen from high on the mezzanine: pale pink walls, a curved glass counter full of colored perfume bottles, and sunbeams slanting in under the yellow-and-white striped awning. A white door stands open to the sunny street at the back. On the left Father Christmas sniffs a jar of pine at the counter, two models in sunglasses strut down the lilac runner, an old painter lets a kitten dab its paws on her palette, a fashion lady poses in a pointy cone hat, a tower of metal washers wobbles on a box, and a palace guard keeps watch by his lantern. In the front a big blue-and-brass steamer trunk stands open with a little crowd of treasures and people around it. On the right a purse spills coins on a stool, a man leaps for joy beside a huge purple jewel, the old watchman finds a lace veil on his lantern, a dandy twirls his mustache in a hand mirror, a jeweler holds amber up to the sun, a gray cat stirs rose oil in a copper bowl, a bee sets gems on a tiered stand, and a lady in a silk robe slips on a jade bangle.

coffre.name: Le coffre
coffre.alt: Close-up of the big open blue-and-brass steamer trunk in the sunny perfumery: a man in a top hat sips his tea and admires the black lace mantilla on a mannequin, a fashion designer pins a dress form, an enchanter holds his top hat upside down as a shiny golden tuba bursts out of it in a puff of sparkles, a seahorse shows off a blue sapphire in its glass bowl, a smiling man looks splendid in a long striped boubou, a lady in pearls and a spotted gown strikes a glamorous pose, and a jeweler at a tiny workbench cheers as he holds up a finished gold ring.

taverne.name: La taverne
taverne.alt: La taverne, a sea-themed old pub on the shopping street, with timber beams, whitewashed walls, fishing nets, a ship's wheel and hanging ship lanterns; pewter mugs stand untouched on a shelf behind the bar and nobody is drinking. By the red door on the left a laughing young woman gives her grinning boyfriend a playful cartoon slap, little stars bursting, while he holds a bunch of flowers. In front of them a comic dust cloud of a scuffle rolls around a big duffel bag, a laughing sailor in a red bandana in the middle of it, nobody hurt. On a table two little cartoon bulls in red boxing gloves spar on a giant apple core. In the middle a tipsy rosy-nosed sailor dances with a potted fir tree, and at the bar a tipsy old fisherman dozes with his nose in his soup. In front, a red-nosed old cook weeps as he peels a big sack of onions. On the right a white-bearded old man with a cold, unlit pipe in his teeth holds a brass tuba; there is no smoke. A wide window at the back right looks out on the shopping street. Door: red wood on the left wall, back out to the shopping street.

doors.label: la rue Commerçante
doors.hint: Go back out through the red door to the shopping street
